summary: V3.5 Panel de Seguimiento a Cotizaciones tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 new pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_v35_seguimiento.py covering regression (director login + >=3 seed cotizaciones with folio DEY-YYYY-#### format), GET /email-template (shape, folio in subject, valid HTML with table/h2/p, body_text starts with 'Estimado(a)'), POST /aprobar-enviar for director (200, status=queued_mock, mock=true, attachments contains cotizacion_FOLIO.pdf application/pdf, estado→aprobada_direccion) and comercial (sent_by_role=comercial), 403 for operaciones, 400 blocking re-aprobacion when estado is final, POST /respuesta for comercial (200, registrado_por_name set) and 403 for operaciones, POST /marcar aceptada+nota (200, estado=aceptada), GET /seguimiento returns sendgrid_enabled=false, sendgrid_from=null, outbound_emails>=1, inbound_replies>=1, historia covers {aprobacion_envio, respuesta_cliente, cambio_estado}. Full regression (V1+V2+V3): 49 passed, 1 skipped, 1 transient 502 on /api/scraper/score-batch (unrelated, infra timeout). Frontend Playwright (director on /cotizador): cotizador-page renders, 7 cot rows, seguimiento-cot-{id} (Eye icon) and download-cot-{id} (Download icon) both present per row, badge 'APROBADA · ENVIADA' visible for previously-approved cotizacion. Click seguimiento-cot opens seguimiento-modal. 4 tabs (seg-tab-resumen/correos/respuestas/historia) render after data loads. open-composer-btn pre-fills subject (48 chars), body_html (2269 chars). composer-send-btn changes estado to 'APROBADA · ENVIADA' immediately. Tab navigation works. Reply form opens; marcar buttons render.

minor.issue: Transient 502 (Cloudflare HTML body) during full regression run — likely ingress timeout because batch can take 60-300s. Not a V3.5 issue; pre-existing from V3.

integration_issues.issue: When the cotización's contact has no email on file (or user leaves DE_EMAIL empty), the frontend submits `de_email: ""` (empty string) instead of omitting the field. Backend Pydantic `Optional[EmailStr] = None` rejects empty string → 422 'value is not a valid email address: An email address must have an @-sign.'. The reply-form-modal stays open with red error and the inbound entry is NOT created, blocking the user from registering responses for cotizaciones whose contact lacks an email. Reproduced: open seguimiento → tab Respuestas → Registrar respuesta del cliente → leave EMAIL DEL REMITENTE empty → click Registrar respuesta → 422.

action_items: (HIGH) Fix POST /respuesta 422 when de_email empty. Two options: (a) Frontend ReplyForm submit() should strip/omit `de_email` if it is empty string (preferred — payload semantics correct), or (b) Backend RegistrarRespuestaIn coerce empty string → None via a validator (e.g. @field_validator('de_email', mode='before')) so `Optional[EmailStr]` accepts both empty string and None. Recommend (a)+(b) for defense in depth. File: /app/frontend/src/components/SeguimientoCotizacionModal.jsx around line 340 (ReplyForm submit) and /app/backend/server.py RegistrarRespuestaIn model (~line 1573).
(LOW) /api/scraper/score-batch regression test occasionally times out at ingress (502) when there are many score=0 items. Consider batching internally or returning 202 with a job id.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug RCA — Frontend integration: ReplyForm pre-fills `de_email: cont.email || ""` (SeguimientoCotizacionModal.jsx line 99). When cont.email is falsy this stays as "". On submit, the payload object contains `de_email: ""` which Pydantic EmailStr rejects with 422. Robust fix: build payload with `...(de_email ? { de_email } : {})` spread, OR add a backend pre-validator that converts empty string to None.

server.py now 2069 lines (was 1790 in V3). The V3.5 Panel de Seguimiento block adds 230 lines (1561–1786). Strongly recommend extracting to /app/backend/routers/cotizaciones_seguimiento.py and /app/backend/services/email_template.py before V4 — the file is becoming hard to navigate.

send_email_sendgrid: when SENDGRID is enabled and `plain_text_content` is None but `html_content` is also None, the function builds a Mail without any content body — SendGrid will reject. Add an explicit guard or always ensure at least one of html/plain is set.

aprobar-enviar persists raw HTML body (2-3KB each) into the Cotizacion document's outbound_emails array. Over many sends this bloats the document past Mongo's 16MB doc limit for large templates. Consider storing only a hash/preview in the cot doc and full bodies in a separate `outbound_emails` collection keyed by cotizacion_id.
_history_entry stores `actor_name` and `actor_role` but no provider/IP/user-agent — for an auditable approval flow consider adding request metadata.

ReplyForm date-input uses HTML `<input type='datetime-local'>` which renders the browser default picker. Spec note in system prompt prefers shadcn calendar; not blocking but inconsistent with rest of UI.
SeguimientoCotizacionModal.jsx is 396 lines and bundles Resumen, Correos, Respuestas, Historia, Composer, ReplyForm and MarcarModal in one file. Split each into its own component for maintainability.
Frontend Resumen tab does not show inbound_replies sentiment summary — minor UX gap.

CotizadorPage ESTADO_BADGE map should include 'enviada' (still in Literal but no entry). Currently only borrador/aprobada_direccion/aceptada/rechazada have badges, so an 'enviada' cot (legacy data) would show `badge undefined`.

rca of the issue: Bug: POST /api/cotizaciones/{id}/respuesta returns 422 when the cot's contact has no email. Reproduction: 1) login director, 2) /cotizador → click seguimiento on any cot whose contact lacks email, 3) tab Respuestas → 'Registrar respuesta del cliente' → fill DE (nombre), ASUNTO, CONTENIDO; leave EMAIL DEL REMITENTE empty, 4) click REGISTRAR RESPUESTA → 422 banner 'value is not a valid email address: An email address must have an @-sign.'. RCA: /app/frontend/src/components/SeguimientoCotizacionModal.jsx line 99 initializes the form with `de_email: cont.email || ""`. On submit (~line 358 — `reply-save-btn`), the entire `data` state object is POSTed verbatim, so empty string `de_email: ""` reaches the backend. Backend Pydantic model RegistrarRespuestaIn (/app/backend/server.py line 1575) declares `de_email: Optional[EmailStr] = None` — Pydantic v2 will validate `""` against EmailStr and fail with the 422 above. Mitigation: strip/omit empty string before sending OR add a `mode='before'` validator on the field that returns `None` for empty/whitespace strings. Either is a 3-line fix.
